Headteachers Welcome
A Warm Welcome from the Headteacher
Hello and welcome to Hatton Special School’s website!
I’m incredibly proud to be the Headteacher of such a vibrant and inclusive school, where nearly 200 amazing children with complex needs come together to learn, grow, and thrive. It’s a real privilege to lead such a dedicated and passionate team who work tirelessly to make sure every child receives the support they need to flourish.
At Hatton, we offer an ambitious and enriching curriculum that’s designed to help our pupils build knowledge, develop skills, and deepen their understanding of themselves and the world around them. We also focus closely on each child’s individual EHCP goals, supporting their communication, social interaction, and emotional regulation every step of the way.
Our staff, including our onsite therapy team, are highly trained and deeply committed to providing personalised support. Together with other professionals, they help our children access learning in a way that’s meaningful and empowering, enabling them to achieve outstanding outcomes.
We’re proud to be one of the few schools in the UK to hold GOLD status as a UNICEF Rights Respecting School. This award reflects our commitment to putting children’s needs and rights at the heart of everything we do. We’re also recognised as a Centre of Excellence for Inclusion – something we’re incredibly proud of.
We know that families play a vital role in their child’s development, and we’re passionate about building strong partnerships with parents and carers. Whether it’s through regular communication, workshops, training, or school visits, we love welcoming families into the Hatton community.
Thank you for visiting our website – we hope you find everything you’re looking for. If you have any questions or need more information, please don’t hesitate to contact our school office or email us at admin@hattonspecialschool.co.uk. We’re always happy to help and can provide information by email or post.

Our School Vision and development
Our School Vision and development
Lighting the fire of curiosity and enquiry in the mind of every pupil.
At Hatton School we believe that our pupils learn best when they are actively involved and, as far as possible, lead their own learning. Our aim is to provide them with the interesting and exciting lessons and resources so they are inspired to join in and explore learning.
Our teachers plan for these learning opportunities and our highly experienced learning support assistants help our pupils as they work towards their learning goals.
Our school community worked together to agree and define our values.
These guide our daily interactions, our decision making and inform our long term plans.
Together we defined them and now, together, we live them out daily in our school community.
Respect: Valuing everyone's beliefs and backgrounds and ensuring all voices are heard
Safety: Creating a secure environment that promotes physical and mental health and wellbeing
Happiness: Creating a positive and encouraging environment where everyone feels fulfilled
Growth: Encouraging continuous improvement and personal development for both students and staff
Community: Building a sense of belonging through shared purpose and mutual support
Our ambitions are our longer term goals that we are aiming form over the next few years. They are the guiding principles that help us see where we want to be and the steps we need to take to get there.
